content:
## Where can I find the latest progress of Java support on {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}?

You can follow us on the [Java at Microsoft](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/java/) blog, which will keep you updated on our progress.

While you're using Java within {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}, you may also see a **Release Notes** section after you update the [Extension Pack for Java](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=vscjava.vscode-java-pack). The notes will give you an overview on the notable updates included in the extensions.
